# 第二次课项目协作规则

本工作区包含课程资料和多个输出子项目。以下研究规则适用于无人网约车论文、引言、相关工作、方法及实验设计等任务；与该论文无关的编码或其他项目任务不必加载研究记忆库。

## 研究记忆库入口与自动维护

- 每次在本工作区开启与无人网约车论文有关的新对话，开始处理前先阅读 output/paper/研究记忆库.md，并以最新用户指示为准。
- 每个相关对话在完成当前任务前，都要检查是否产生了新的稳定结论、用户纠正、教师反馈、文献事实或实验结果。若有，主动增量更新研究记忆库，并在“更新记录”中写入日期和更新内容；若没有，不要为了形式制造空改动。
- 更新时标明证据类型：用户确认、教师建议、出版方论文事实、方案待验证、已完成实验。保留来源链接、课程时间戳或本地材料路径。
- 用户最新指示优先于旧记忆。遇到冲突时，记录新决定及其日期，并把旧结论标为“已被更新”，不要静默删除历史。
- 不得把设想、Demo 复现、模拟结果、真实部署结果混为一谈；没有实验数据和可复现记录时，不得写成效果结论。
- 不得仅凭“多 Agent”“LLM+优化器”或“Agent 友好地图”等组合宣称首创。相关新颖性和性能主张须有文献比较或实验支持。
- 未决事项继续逐项澄清，一次只向用户提出一个问题；若不妨碍当前起草，先写明暂定假设并继续。

## 写作风格

- 用户提出“去 AI 味”“说人话”“自然一点”“别像模板”等要求时，使用本地 skill shuorenhua。对外文本优先按它处理；代码、日志、配置和命令输出不套用该 skill。

## 引言（修订稿）

一对一无人网约车平台需要根据持续到达的订单和变化中的车队状态，在线决定车辆与订单的匹配，并规划车辆驶向乘客指定上车点的接驾路线。每辆车同一时刻服务一名乘客，完成当前订单后再进入下一次服务；这一研究边界与课程讨论中“不是拼车”的说明一致（[第三次课逐字稿，29:50–30:20](https://meeting.tencent.com/cw/l5GXJpae01)）。乘客从提交订单到车辆抵达上车点的等待，涉及在线匹配和实际接驾两个阶段。Li 等人对这两个阶段分别建模；本文则按当前研究设定，将乘客等待时间定义为**调度计算时间与车辆驶往指定上车点的运行时间之和**[1](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.trb.2024.103070)。在此基础上，本文拟将最大等待时间设为硬约束，优先最小化平均等待时间，再在不损害该时间目标的前提下优化资源成本。

动态网约车调度已有在线优化和多智能体学习等研究基础。Gao 等人研究了在线订单匹配与车辆再平衡的模块化优化方法[2](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tre.2024.103600)；Guo 等人针对无人服务车辆派单，建立了同时考虑乘客等待、行驶距离、供需平衡等因素的多目标框架[3](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cie.2024.110385)。Jing 等人提出 FedMARL4OD，让车辆使用本地多智能体强化学习模型，并通过联邦学习协调全局模型[4](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eswa.2024.125792)。这些工作表明，数学优化和多智能体学习均已被用于动态派单相关问题；本文不预设它们不能处理动态需求，而是关注在本文的一对一无人网约车设定下，如何组织单车路线评估与全局车辆—订单分配。

地图层也不仅是派单模型的障碍约束。已有研究分别从接客点推荐和自主导航地图表示等角度处理道路信息：Liu 等人的网约车研究利用道路网络及乘客相关特征推荐候选上车位置，但其任务是选择上车位置，与本文车辆抵达乘客指定位置的任务不同[5](https://doi.org/10.1109/TMC.2022.3208566)；Chen 等人构建了可供规划与控制模块使用的道路几何和拓扑表示[6](https://doi.org/10.1109/LRA.2025.3544456)，ETPNav 则将拓扑地图用于视觉语言导航 Agent 的规划[7](https://doi.org/10.1109/TPAMI.2024.3386695)。这些工作提示地图表示可以参与 Agent 的规划过程，但不等同于本文的多车派单问题。本文因此拟研究面向车辆 Agent 的地图表示与查询方式：将已知路网的连接关系、通行属性、预设障碍和场景约束组织成 Agent 可读取、可查询的状态，并将指定上车点的可达性及候选路线时间和资源代价，按统一形式提供给全局优化器。仿真场景将采用预先给定的路网和障碍，以及可配置约束；研究重点是地图如何支持 Agent 完成接驾路线评估，而不是增加复杂的实时感知条件。

LLM 与数学优化器结合也已有直接相关工作。Zhang 等人在 NeurIPS 2025 论文中使用 LLM 生成上层目标，再由数学优化器执行带约束的调度与路线决策，并根据反馈迭代调整目标[8](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/file/dc8f650f21f1a0c5dc4f7f8ade889de8-Paper-Conference.pdf)。因此，本文不把“LLM 与数学优化器结合”本身作为创新主张。按照目前的研究设想，每辆无人车对应一个 Agent，Agent 工作流中包含可调用的 LLM 组件，而全局车辆—订单分配由数学优化器决定；LLM 在 Agent 内具体承担什么任务、何时调用，仍待后续方案确定。

基于上述研究，本文拟在模拟环境中研究一对一无人网约车动态派单，重点包括：

1. **多 Agent 调度工作流。** 为每辆无人车配置一个 Agent，明确单车路线评估与全局派单优化器之间的信息交互。
2. **Agent 友好地图表示。** 设计车辆 Agent 可读取和查询的路网与道路特征表示，并研究其如何支持车辆到达乘客指定上车点的路线评估。
3. **时间优先的协同派单。** 将最大等待时间作为硬约束，先优化乘客平均等待时间，再优化路线运行与调度计算所消耗的资源；通过模拟对照检验各部分的作用，不预设其优于现有方法。

### 本稿采用的文献

[1] Li et al., “An aggregate matching and pick-up model for mobility-on-demand services,” *Transportation Research Part B*, 190, 103070, 2024.\
[2] Gao et al., “Online relocating and matching of ride-hailing services: A model-based modular approach,” *Transportation Research Part E*, 188, 103600, 2024.\
[3] Guo et al., “Enhancing efficiency and interpretability: A multi-objective dispatching strategy for autonomous service vehicles in ride-hailing,” *Computers & Industrial Engineering*, 194, 110385, 2024.\
[4] Jing et al., “Scalable order dispatching through Federated Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning,” *Expert Systems with Applications*, 264, 125792, 2025.\
[5] Liu et al., “Data-Driven Pick-Up Location Recommendation for Ride-Hailing Services,” *IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing*, 23(2), 1001–1015, 2024.\
[6] Chen et al., “Online Temporal Fusion for Vectorized Map Construction in Mapless Autonomous Driving,” *IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters*, 10(4), 3948–3955, 2025.\
[7] “ETPNav: Evolving Topological Planning for Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments,” *IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence*, 47(7), 5130–5145, 2025.\
[8] Zhang et al., “Hierarchical Optimization via LLM-Guided Objective Evolution for Mobility-on-Demand Systems,” NeurIPS 2025 **会议论文**，作为直接相关先行工作单独列出，不计作期刊文献。

\*\*暂定解释：\*\*文中“先优化时间、再优化成本”按字典序理解：先在最大等待时间约束下最小化平均等待时间，再在保持时间最优值的方案中优化资源成本。若模拟中供需不足导致约束不可行，应报告超时订单或积压情况，不能预设所有订单都能满足阈值。成本的具体计算单位和各项资源如何合并，仍需在模型设计阶段明确。

以上论文的出版信息已按出版方页面核对；期刊的 WoS、EI 收录状态和学校采用的分区口径，还需以相应数据库的当前记录为准。

# SOP Init

Read [user-direction.md](../coding-sop/references/user-direction.md) before applying this Skill.
Explicit user skips and blocker waivers take precedence over this Skill's
normal stop/approval rules; record them once and continue the adjusted work.

Read [output-language.md](../coding-sop/references/output-language.md) before generating user-facing text or documents.

Read `references/init-contract.md`. Run the safety preflight and then the two
phases in order. The first phase is always read-only; the second may write
project docs only after its preview is approved.

## Phase 0: docs safety preflight

Resolve `SKILL_DIR` to this loaded Skill directory, `PLUGIN_ROOT` to
`SKILL_DIR/../..`, and select an explicit absolute target path, otherwise the
current working directory. Before invoking the init CLI or reading project
`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, or `docs/`, run:

```bash
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/preflight_docs_scan.py" "$PROJECT_ROOT"
```

Retain this result for Phase 2. Only inspect returned `safePaths`;
never inspect `unsafeAliases` or `blockedPaths`, and add them to
`conflicts`. The preflight is metadata-only.

## Phase 1: persisted context inspection

Resolve the CLI to the absolute path
`PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/init_cli.py`. Never use a development checkout path,
current working directory, or fixed plugin-cache version to locate it.
Run it as `python3 "$CLI"`; do not rely on the entry file's executable bit.

1. Use the explicit target selected in Phase 0.
2. Encode one UTF-8 JSON request with a JSON encoder and pipe it to the CLI on
   standard input:

   ```json
   {
     "schema_version": "ai-native-devkit/v1alpha1",
     "operation": "init",
     "repository": {"path": "/absolute/target/path"},
     "user_request": "original user request or stable reference"
   }
   ```

3. For an initial request only, omit `task_id`. The CLI may use
   `CODEX_THREAD_ID`, then `CODEX_TASK_ID`, as an implicit candidate identity.
   If that candidate is already bound to a different explicitly selected
   repository target, the CLI creates a fresh Workflow Task and returns its new
   `report.task_id` without rebinding or mutating the existing task. Retain the
   returned `report.task_id` and exact top-level `report_ref`. Any supplied
   `task_id`, `choice`, `authority_grant`, or `instruction_selection` is a strict continuation: a target
   mismatch is `init.task_target_mismatch` and must not be retried under a new
   ID. Repository path never selects an existing task.
4. Treat response `kind` as exhaustive:
   - `report`: retain the persisted `InitReport`. Continue only when its outcome
     is `ready`; for instruction differences follow the selection flow in
     `references/init-contract.md`. For other `blocked` results, report the
     typed recovery condition and stop.
   - `choice_required`: ask only the returned `reuse | new | cancel` choice and
     stop the current assistant turn. Call the CLI again only after a later user
     message makes that explicit choice; the original development request,
     general autonomy, or silence is not a choice. Do not call the CLI again in
     the same turn.
   - `runtime_error`: report its stable code and bounded message; do not
     fabricate state or blindly retry an invariant failure.
5. A later authority grant is permitted only after the user grants the exact
   `repository.read` capability and canonical `repository:v1:<encoded-scope>`
   requested by the latest blocker.

   Present the exact capability and scope, then stop the current assistant
   turn. Only a later user message that explicitly grants that exact authority
   permits the retry. The original development request is not approval; neither
   are general autonomy or silence. Do not retry in the same turn.

   Reuse the original `task_id`, `repository`, and `user_request`; derive the
   scope from `report.payload.repository.requested_scope`. Encode null as `.`.
   Otherwise RFC 3986 percent-encode the UTF-8 repository-relative path with
   uppercase hex, preserving `/` and unreserved characters (`A-Z`, `a-z`,
   `0-9`, `-`, `.`, `_`, `~`), then prefix it with `repository:v1:`. Encode the
   retry with a JSON encoder in this complete shape:

   ```json
   {
     "schema_version": "ai-native-devkit/v1alpha1",
     "operation": "init",
     "task_id": "exact-blocked-task-id",
     "repository": {"path": "/same/absolute/target/path"},
     "user_request": "same original user request or stable reference",
     "authority_grant": {
       "capabilities": ["repository.read"],
       "scopes": ["repository:v1:."],
       "confirmed_at": "RFC-3339 timestamp",
       "provenance": "stable user-confirmation reference"
     }
   }
   ```

   Do not send an authority grant for any other blocker.

This phase must not initialize Git, mutate the repository, inspect persistence
files directly, dump raw source content, or create docs or scratch files.

## Phase 2: project docs preparation

After a ready context report:

**Boundary: exclude from semantic inventory; deterministic index/link
preservation only.**

Exclude every descendant of `docs/superpowers/requirements/`,
`docs/superpowers/specs/`, and `docs/superpowers/plans/` from semantic
inventory even when Phase 0 reports it in `safePaths`. Preserve those files
byte-for-byte; do not open, summarize, migrate, promote, or use them to infer
the current task. Deterministic index/link preservation is allowed. A routed
stage may consume an explicitly supplied approved reference later.

1. Inventory the repository and only the safe project-entry/docs paths returned
   by Phase 0. Do not follow symlinks and always exclude `docs/handoff/`.
2. Select `Bootstrap` when no usable docs exist, `Adapt` when useful
   non-standard docs exist, or `Refresh` when the standard structure exists.
   Bootstrap does not create `docs/README.md`; `AGENTS.md` or `CLAUDE.md` routes
   directly to each relevant child directory `README.md`.
3. Run `python3 scripts/check_managed_docs.py PROJECT_ROOT` from this Skill directory.
   Add missing managed runbook creation and `OUTDATED_UNMODIFIED` upgrades to the proposed
   changes. Preserve `LOCAL_MODIFIED` copies. Show a diff only when `localHash` is non-null;
   a null hash marks an unsafe alias that must not be inspected or replaced.
   Do not write managed docs before the preview.
4. Preview creates, moves, merges, splits, semantic additions, preserved files,
   and conflicts. Ask for confirmation before moves, merges, splits, or
   semantic additions. When the preview contains repository writes, state that
   approval also authorizes creation of a fresh post-write Workflow Task so the
   next stage does not inherit a stale pre-write revision.
   If the preview contains any repository write, persist or otherwise retain
   the complete preview, present the exact preview, and stop the current
   assistant turn. Do not apply the preview, run post-write init, or enter
   Clarify in the same turn. Only a later user message that explicitly approves
   the exact preview authorizes those writes. The original development request
   is not approval; neither are general autonomy, silence, or an unrelated
   follow-up. If the preview contains no repository write, this pause is not
   required.
5. Preserve valid content and prefer repository evidence over weaker prose.
   Preserve an existing `docs/README.md`. If it contains unique durable facts,
   include their destination and complete content in a migration preview. Only
   propose deleting the old file after all unique content has an approved home;
   never delete or rewrite it silently.
6. Apply approved changes and the Chinese project entry/docs structure from
   `assets/AGENTS.md` and `assets/docs-template/`. The template contains child
   indexes but no root docs README. Create and populate the five fixed
   `docs/overview/` documents; do not replace them with an aggregate file such as
   `project-overview.md`. Copy the four managed platform runbooks without adding
   project-specific resource identifiers or secrets.
7. From this Skill directory run
   `python3 scripts/validate_project_docs.py PROJECT_ROOT`.
   The validator automatically compares the code-owned pre-Init docs inventory
   with the validated result and records recognized, generated, overwritten,
   preserved, removed, and conflicting paths in Trace. Do not rescan, summarize,
   or ask the user for any Trace-only data.
8. If this phase changed `AGENTS.md` or `docs/`, do not hand the original
   pre-write report to clarification. After successful docs validation, call
   `init_cli.py` again with the original `task_id` and explicit `choice: new`;
   retain the new ready task ID and report reference. If the post-write
   inspection blocks or errors, stop before downstream work. If no repository
   file changed, retain the original ready report.
9. Return a `DocsInitReport`, then combine both phases as `InitOutcome` with
   `task_id`, `context_ref`, `context_outcome`, and `docs`.

Human-facing Handoff documents are outside plugin scope. Do not inspect,
create, migrate, update, or ask about them. Init silently excludes them
from project context and leaves existing content untouched.

`DocsInitReport` keeps the existing docs contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "Bootstrap | Adapt | Refresh",
  "scanned": [],
  "created": [],
  "modified": [],
  "preserved": [],
  "conflicts": [],
  "validation": {"valid": true, "missing": [], "brokenLinks": []}
}
```

name: research-paper-writing
description: Improve academic paper writing quality for ML/CV/NLP-style papers with clear section structure, paragraph flow, and reviewer-facing presentation. # Research Paper Writing

## Overview

Use this skill to rewrite a research paper into a reviewer-friendly, high-clarity draft.
Prioritize first-impression quality (figures/tables/layout), logical flow, and evidence-backed claims.

## Core Workflow

1. Clarify the paper story before sentence-level edits.
2. Use section-specific guidance in `references/`.
3. Rewrite paragraph-by-paragraph with one message per paragraph.
4. Run reverse outlining after writing each section.
5. Check every major claim in Abstract/Introduction against experimental evidence.
6. Run final-paper adversarial review with `references/paper-review.md`.

## Global Principles

1. Keep one paragraph for one message only.
2. State the paragraph message in the first sentence.
3. Make nouns self-contained; define new terms before reusing them.
4. Maintain sentence-to-sentence flow (cause, contrast, consequence, or refinement).
5. Iterate with adversarial self-review: read as a skeptical reviewer.
6. Treat visual quality as core content, not decoration.
7. Use a clean teaser and pipeline figure.
8. Use readable, minimal-ink tables.
9. Keep formatting consistent and tidy.

## Paragraph Clarity Check (Important)

Use this quick test whenever the user asks whether a paragraph "flows" or is clear.

1. Read as an external reader:
   - Does this paragraph have one explicit message?
   - Does the first sentence state what this paragraph will do?
   - Are all key nouns/terms readable without hidden context?
   - Does each sentence connect to the previous one with a clear relation (cause, contrast, consequence, refinement, example)?
2. Run reverse outlining for the current section:
   - Write down thesis/main claim.
   - Write down each paragraph topic sentence.
   - Write down the evidence/explanation points under each paragraph.
   - Check mapping: topic sentence -> thesis, and evidence -> topic sentence.
   - Revise or remove any paragraph that cannot be mapped cleanly.
3. If flow is still weak, add temporary section headers and explicit transition phrases during revision, then remove unnecessary headers before finalizing.

Source reference for this check:

- `references/does-my-writing-flow-source.md`

## Section Guides

Load only the needed section file:

- Introduction: `references/introduction.md`
- Abstract: `references/abstract.md`
- Related Work: `references/related-work.md`
- Method: `references/method.md`
- Experiments: `references/experiments.md`
- Conclusion: `references/conclusion.md`
- Paper review (Paper Review): `references/paper-review.md`
- Paragraph clarity source: `references/does-my-writing-flow-source.md`
- Example bank index: `references/examples/index.md`

## Paper Review Core Points

Use `references/paper-review.md` for the full checklist and workflow.

1. Add an end-of-draft self-review question list in five dimensions:
   - contribution,
   - writing clarity,
   - experimental strength,
   - evaluation completeness,
   - method design soundness.
2. Treat claim-evidence alignment as a hard constraint, especially for Abstract and Introduction.
3. Perform adversarial writing: review as a skeptical reviewer and resolve every high-risk question.
4. Revise until major rejection risks are explicitly addressed.

## Execution Rules

1. Build a mini-outline before drafting prose.
2. For each subsection, explicitly include motivation, design, and technical advantage when applicable.
3. Avoid writing style that looks like incremental patching of a naive baseline.
4. Keep terminology stable across the full paper.
5. If a claim cannot be supported by results, weaken or remove the claim.
6. Before finalizing, append and answer a five-dimension self-review question list, then revise the paper based on unresolved items.

## 引言修订稿

**第1段｜问题界定与优化目标**

本文研究一对一无人网约车平台中的动态派单与接驾路线评估。随着订单持续到达、车辆位置和可用状态不断变化，平台需要在线完成车辆—订单匹配，并规划车辆驶向乘客指定上车点的路线。每辆车同一时刻服务一名乘客，完成当前订单后再开始下一单；这一边界与课程讨论中“不是拼车”的说明一致（[第三次课逐字稿，29:50–30:20](https://meeting.tencent.com/cw/l5GXJpae01)）。本文将乘客等待时间操作性地定义为派单计算时间与车辆从当前位置驶至指定上车点的运行时间之和。Li 等人以稳态聚合模型刻画匹配与接驾过程，为区分这两类耗时提供了参照；本文采用的具体合计口径则是针对本研究作出的定义[1]。在此基础上，本文将最大等待时间设为硬约束，并采用字典序目标：先最小化平均等待时间，再在平均等待时间最优的可行方案中优化系统资源成本。资源成本拟涉及路线运行与调度计算，其计量单位及合并方式仍需在方法部分明确。若供需不足或约束导致问题不可行，实验将报告超时、未服务订单或积压情况，不预设所有订单都能在阈值内完成。

**第2段｜动态派单相关工作与研究焦点**

动态网约车派单已有在线优化、多目标优化和多智能体学习等研究。Gao 等人提出在线订单匹配与车辆再平衡的模块化方法[2]；Guo 等人研究无人服务车辆的多目标派单[3]；Jing 等人则将联邦学习与多智能体深度强化学习用于订单派单[4]。这些工作表明，优化方法和学习方法都已用于动态派单问题。因此，本文不预设其中任何一类方法无法适应动态需求，而聚焦于当前研究设定中的一个具体问题：如何评估车辆驶向乘客指定上车点的路线可行性与代价，并将这些信息以统一形式纳入全局车辆—订单分配。

**第3段｜地图相关工作与研究焦点**

地图表示会影响车辆对路网可达性和路线代价的评估，但相邻研究处理的任务并不相同。Liu 等人根据乘客需求和道路网络推荐候选上车位置[5]，其目标是选择上车点，而不是让车辆抵达乘客已指定的位置。Chen 等人构建了供规划与控制使用的道路几何和拓扑表示[6]；ETPNav 则将拓扑地图用于视觉语言导航 Agent 的规划[7]。这些研究说明地图信息可以参与规划，但不能直接证明某种地图表示适用于多车派单。本文拟研究面向车辆 Agent 的地图表示与查询方式：在预先给定的路网、通行属性、障碍和场景约束中，组织 Agent 可读取、可查询的状态；再由路线评估模块判断指定上车点是否可达，并将候选路线的时间和资源代价传给全局优化器。模拟重点是地图如何支持接驾路线评估，不涉及复杂的实时感知条件。

**第4段｜LLM 与优化器的研究边界**

LLM 与数学优化器结合已有直接相关工作。Zhang 等人在 NeurIPS 2025 论文中利用 LLM 生成上层目标，由数学优化器执行带约束的调度与路线决策，并根据优化反馈迭代调整目标[8]。因此，本文不把“LLM 与数学优化器结合”本身作为创新主张。按当前研究设想，每辆无人车对应一个 Agent，Agent 工作流中包含可调用的 LLM 组件，全局车辆—订单分配由数学优化器负责；LLM 在 Agent 内承担什么任务、何时调用，仍待方案设计确定。

**第5段｜拟研究内容**

本文拟在模拟环境中研究一对一无人网约车动态派单，重点包括：

1. **多 Agent 调度工作流：** 为每辆无人车配置一个 Agent，明确单车路线评估与全局派单优化器之间的信息接口。
2. **面向 Agent 的地图表示：** 设计车辆 Agent 可读取和查询的路网及道路特征表示，研究其对指定上车点可达性和接驾路线评估的支持方式。
3. **时间优先的协同派单：** 在最大等待时间约束下先优化平均等待时间，再优化资源成本；通过模拟对照检验各部分的作用，并如实报告约束不可行、超时或积压情况，不预设方法优于现有方案。

## 主要主张与证据对应

- **匹配与接驾是可区分的等待阶段**｜Li 等人的研究描述了稳态服务市场中的匹配与接驾过程[1](https://smusg.elsevierpure.com/en/publications/an-aggregate-matching-and-pick-up-model-for-mobility-on-demand-se/)；本文将两类耗时相加是本研究的操作性定义，并非照搬其动态模型。
- **优化与学习方法已用于动态派单**｜Gao 等人的在线匹配与再平衡方法[2](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1366554524001911)、Guo 等人的无人服务车辆多目标派单[3](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0360835224005060)、Jing 等人的联邦多智能体派单方法[4](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0957417424026599)支持这一概述。
- **地图相关研究与本文任务存在边界差异**｜Liu 等人研究候选上车点推荐[5](https://researchportal.hkust.edu.hk/en/publications/data-driven-pick-up-location-recommendation-for-ride-hailing-serv/)；Chen 等人研究供规划与控制使用的矢量地图[6](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10897810/)；ETPNav 研究视觉语言导航中的拓扑规划[7](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10495141/)。
- **LLM 与优化器已有直接先行工作**｜Zhang 等人的 NeurIPS 2025 论文描述了 LLM 生成上层目标、优化器处理约束决策并利用反馈迭代[8](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/file/dc8f650f21f1a0c5dc4f7f8ade889de8-Paper-Conference.pdf)。
- **本文拟研究的工作流、地图接口和时间优先目标**｜证据来自当前研究设定；它们仍是待实现、待实验验证的方案，不能作为已完成的方法或效果结论。
